headline: Harvard data breach by ShinyHunters exposed 851,000 alumni and donor accounts
summary: Hackers linked to the ShinyHunters group breached Harvard University's Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025, exposing personal and donation data tied to more than 850,000 unique email addresses belonging to alumni, donors, students and family members. The breach was reported by a breach notification service about a year after the attack occurred.
